# **✍️ Quick notes**  

## **BCA Europe Requirements**

  

Sep 3, 2026

[Gerardo Cabanas](mailto:gerardo.cabanas@draiver.com) [Paloma Calderon](mailto:paloma.calderon@draiver.com) [Kevin Burke](mailto:kevin@draiver.com) [Fede Ranero](mailto:fede.ranero@draiver.com) [Armando Flores](mailto:armando.flores@draiver.com) [Nicolas Ariza](mailto:nicolas.ariza@kavak.com) [Nicolas Ariza](mailto:nicolas.ariza@draiver.com)

  

Discussion on British Car Auctions strategy and financial opportunity via technical evaluation.

  

## **British Car Auctions (BCA) partnership strategy**

  - BCA is centralizing logistics operations across 13 European countries into a new tech hub based in Lisbon.
  - Nicolas estimated the annual opportunity at 1.8 million euros from move volume, excluding potential SAS revenue.
  - The team aligned on operating as a solution provider rather than a software factory, focusing on strategic, high-value delivery.

  

## **Feature requirement evaluation and prioritization**

  - Kevin assessed that approximately 10 percent of the 19 requested BCA features are native to the current platform.
  - The group categorized feature requests into tiers to clarify native capabilities, partner integrations, and necessary future development.
  - Armando recommended evaluating integrations with existing client CRM and finance systems instead of building custom modules.
  - Paloma proposed treating the engagement as a regional expansion to effectively manage infrastructure and custom invoice requirements.

  

## **Resource allocation and execution planning**

  - Kevin identified an available mid-level, AI-native backend developer candidate for immediate onboarding.
  - The team agreed to adopt a consulting-led approach to bridge gaps between existing platform capabilities and client needs.
  - Nicolas prioritized clarifying the project roadmap through a direct follow-up meeting with BCA leadership.

  

## **Next steps**

  - \[Kevin Burke, Paloma Calderon\] Review Requirements: Review the requirements list from British Car Auctions to distinguish between native product features, in-progress items, and necessary custom modifications. Identify which categories align with strategic development goals.
  - \[Nicolas Ariza Bagoud\] Schedule Client Call: Contact Anders and Mikl to schedule a meeting between next Monday and Wednesday. Ensure Fede is included in the invitation.
  - \[The group\] Evaluate Feature List: Provide feedback on the requirements grid by the 17th to confirm which features the system currently supports. Determine which requested items are feasible and which require further development or strategic evaluation.
  - \[Kevin Burke, Paloma Calderon\] Update Feature Grid: Populate the feature documentation grid with supporting evidence for each feature category. Detail existing capabilities to assist in the presentation preparation.
  - \[Nicolas Ariza Bagoud\] Prepare Presentation Slides: Design the summary and follow-up presentation slides with product screens and descriptive bullets. Include relevant questions to facilitate the client discussion.

 Sep 3, 2026

## **BCA Europe Requirements**

Invited [Gerardo Cabanas](mailto:gerardo.cabanas@draiver.com) [Paloma Calderon](mailto:paloma.calderon@draiver.com) [Kevin Burke](mailto:kevin@draiver.com) [Fede Ranero](mailto:fede.ranero@draiver.com) [Armando Flores](mailto:armando.flores@draiver.com) [Nicolas Ariza](mailto:nicolas.ariza@kavak.com) [Nicolas Ariza](mailto:nicolas.ariza@draiver.com)

Attachments [BCA Europe Requirements](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/event?eid=NG5wbnNsc2J1czQ4NDZuOWc4NGIwdDRpMW4gbmljb2xhcy5hcml6YUBkcmFpdmVyLmNvbQ)

Meeting records [Transcript](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?usp=drive_web&tab=t.d32i58bnm059) 

  
  

### **Summary**

Discussion on British Car Auctions strategy and financial opportunity via technical evaluation.  
  
**Strategic context and opportunity**  
British Car Auctions represents a major engagement opportunity with significant annual SaaS and move volume revenue potential in Europe.  
  
**Operational complexity and platform strategy**  
The client requires a complex system involving CRM and fleet management, forcing the team to evaluate custom development versus partner integrations.  
  
**Feature prioritization and consulting approach**  
Categorization of requested features and adoption of a solution provider mindset will guide the upcoming client engagement.

  
  

### **Decisions**

## **Needs Further Discussion**

  - **Status of the BCA engagement pursuit** The group deferred a final decision on pursuing the BCA FTL engagement pending completion of feature mapping and upcoming stakeholder discussions.

  

## **Aligned**

  - **Approach for the initial client proposal** The team agreed to present a simplified, scoped perspective of current platform capabilities rather than attempting to custom-build BCA's entire requested feature list during the initial meeting.

  
  

### **Next steps**

  - \[Kevin Burke, Paloma Calderon\] Review Requirements: Review the requirements list from British Car Auctions to distinguish between native product features, in-progress items, and necessary custom modifications. Identify which categories align with strategic development goals.
  - \[Nicolas Ariza Bagoud\] Schedule Client Call: Contact Anders and Mikl to schedule a meeting between next Monday and Wednesday. Ensure Fede is included in the invitation.
  - \[The group\] Evaluate Feature List: Provide feedback on the requirements grid by the 17th to confirm which features the system currently supports. Determine which requested items are feasible and which require further development or strategic evaluation.
  - \[Kevin Burke, Paloma Calderon\] Update Feature Grid: Populate the feature documentation grid with supporting evidence for each feature category. Detail existing capabilities to assist in the presentation preparation.
  - \[Nicolas Ariza Bagoud\] Prepare Presentation Slides: Design the summary and follow-up presentation slides with product screens and descriptive bullets. Include relevant questions to facilitate the client discussion.

  
  

### **Details**

  - **NIFcif Tax Identification**: Kevin Burke inquired about the "NIFcif" field required for Spanish account invoices, seeking to understand if it is a standard tracking requirement for all business accounts. Armando Flores and Nicolas Ariza Bagoud clarified that this is the fiscal identification of the company, comparable to the RFC in Mexico, and it is a necessary communication field for tax authorities on every invoice ([00:00:10](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.qyriih5ofkf4)).

  - **British Car Auctions (BCA) Strategic Context**: Nicolas Ariza Bagoud provided context on the engagement with British Car Auctions, which is the largest auction house in both Spain and Europe. BCA operates across 13 countries and is currently establishing a centralized tech hub in Lisbon and a centralized logistics arm ([00:03:21](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.h3psoq1sbx94)). As of 2025, they aim to manage approximately 300,000 vehicles using a fleet of 150 trucks, with the objective of centralizing all logistics operations across markets ([00:04:37](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.otxy93iiajdf)).
  - **European Logistics Pain Points**: The team identified the movement of vehicles across European markets as a significant challenge, specifically due to paperwork requirements that can cause delays of 30 days or more between purchase and transport ([00:06:11](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.yreaide9vrfl)). Nicolas Ariza Bagoud noted that while they have not yet identified a solution for this, it represents a major pain point for BCA as they attempt to manage defleeting processes across Europe ([00:07:43](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.tacwn3b4mh3h)).
  - **BCA Pilot and Funding Expectations**: Nicolas Ariza Bagoud explained that BCA is interested in a pilot in Spain to either remove or heavily track their current provider ([00:07:43](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.tacwn3b4mh3h)). The client understands that a full solution is not currently available but is willing to fund ad hoc developments to bridge functionality gaps ([00:08:52](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.3j8kk7c51do)).
  - **Operational Challenges and Complexity**: Paloma Calderon raised concerns regarding the complexity of the request, noting that the client appears to want a comprehensive system—a mix of Salesforce, command center, and ERP—to manage their own customers, transport providers, and accounting ([00:09:59](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.f6lf8jr5yvfk)) ([00:18:42](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.wnxzjirr6z9a)). The team discussed that this would require building a platform that allows BCA to manage multiple pools of contractors and provide them with their own white-labeled interface, adding significant architectural complexity compared to a standard turnkey solution ([00:09:59](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.f6lf8jr5yvfk)) ([00:19:49](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.radxn2lhh862)).
  - **Market Opportunity and Financial Sizing**: The team estimated the potential value of the BCA engagement in Spain. The pure SaaS revenue is estimated at 70,000 euros annually ([00:12:31](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.x7htnw5ou2wj)) ([00:20:50](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.kc9hovp6jwob)). Additionally, capturing 30% of their move volume (approximately 15,000 moves) at a rate of 120 euros per move represents an upside of 1.8 million euros per year, providing a significant financial justification for pursuing the engagement ([00:11:22](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.an8cm488ask1)) ([00:13:48](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.x1rstngklafm)).
  - **Product and Feature Prioritization**: The team discussed the list of 19 features requested by BCA ([00:16:18](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.4x1qkldj3was)). Kevin Burke suggested conducting a detailed exercise to categorize these requirements into "green" (aligned), "yellow" (in progress), "orange" (adaptable), and "white" (non-existent) to manage client expectations ([00:23:00](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.jhpfi9qya42p)). The team agreed that focusing on high-impact, achievable features is necessary to avoid over-committing to custom building items that offer low long-term strategic value ([00:14:53](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.6g2ijhylv78h)) ([00:23:57](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.46l04let7qsy)).

  - **Consulting and Strategic Approach**: Fede Ranero and Nicolas Ariza Bagoud emphasized that the team must approach BCA as a solution provider rather than a software factory ([00:34:53](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.397wxfmf96ts)). They noted that BCA lacks in-house technical capabilities and desires an all-in-one provider that includes consulting, implementation, and SaaS services ([00:21:47](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.11n2tjfugg72)) ([00:32:09](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.c90chbyugxvb)). The team plans to frame the conversation around the "three-for-one" value proposition: SaaS, consulting, and the marketplace/drive-away services ([00:33:48](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.dshjgqnw34mo)).

  - **Engagement with BCA Leadership**: Nicolas Ariza Bagoud committed to contacting Anders and Mikl to schedule a follow-up call, likely between Monday and Wednesday of the following week. Fede Ranero will be invited to participate to provide a high-level perspective on what the company can and cannot deliver ([00:26:32](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.betmpjtnpvxt)) ([00:32:09](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.c90chbyugxvb)).
  - **Market Differences and Service Scope**: Fede Ranero highlighted that differences between the US and Spanish markets often result in more generalized, high-level requests from senior stakeholders in Spain ([00:29:35](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.27y592nb7tmq)). He noted that the team needs to bring a clear, structured perspective to the next meeting, explicitly stating what they will build, what they will not build, and what conditions are required for the development of custom features ([00:31:29](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.dfa622ka0wko)).
  - **FDE Role and Development Pipeline**: Kevin Burke provided an update on the Full-time Development Engineer (FDE) pipeline, noting they are close to extending an offer to a mid-level candidate who could start immediately ([00:36:15](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.l7b46zuk1dpq)). The team discussed utilizing this role to build standalone solutions or integrations for BCA, even if those solutions do not fit perfectly into the core long-term platform roadmap ([00:37:09](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.vj4hefvxcy33)).
  - **Platform Strategy and Invoicing**: A discussion occurred regarding the strategic direction of the platform. Kevin Burke noted that while they can build a portal for BCA to manage their own customers, the platform is currently not designed to generate invoices on behalf of third parties. The team needs to decide if they want to move toward a B2B2C model or remain a logistics executor ([00:38:59](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.ulppdm8roy4r)) ([00:51:16](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.akw4q1oyag57)).

  - **Specific Feature Capabilities**: The team reviewed specific requirements such as fleet management, CRM, and documentation ([00:48:35](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.d1te0lvtpqi6)). They determined that certain functions, like fleet management, are better handled through integrations with existing partners rather than internal development ([00:49:40](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.twzrjd4ug8a3)). Regarding documentation, such as Electronic Consignment Notes (eCMR), the team noted that they currently have some capabilities and could adapt others to meet client needs ([00:44:10](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.s88pyl6q7hvz)).
  - **Next Steps for Documentation**: Kevin Burke and Paloma Calderon will work on filling out the feature documentation with technical detail to support the upcoming client meeting. Nicolas Ariza Bagoud will prepare the summary slides, using the agreed-upon color-coded categorization to clearly communicate the current product scope and roadmap to BCA ([00:47:40](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.l1a3zch8ld7w)) ([00:56:33](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1iBKq5J6LmDd990agE30oavlVJkOCSYtcmZK7OQKj7W0/edit?ouid=107114406729300780928#heading=h.g3iol48e566q)).
